title: Illustrative comparison: average Kickstarter funders versus the 1,000 true-fan benchmark
caption: Only the 241 is a reported figure; the 1,000 is Kelly's rule-of-thumb target, shown for comparison. Even so, it is well above what a typical successful campaign needed.
source: Crowdfunding paragraph: 241 funders on average; 1,000 is the essay's benchmark, not a measured count.
